buckets.label: Technical electives
buckets.note: Two courses from the departmental approved list; must meet ABET standards and be pre-approved. BENG 196/199 may count; 197/198 do not. Exact set from the department's official BE27 pre-approved TE list (TE List - BTEC, last updated May 2023, https://bioengineering.ucsd.edu/sites/default/files/uploads/TE%20List%20-%20BTEC%205.12.pdf). Requirement is 8 units total (2 courses), of which 6 units must have 'engineering' as primary component. Explicit approved list, not open-ended ranges, so specific courses are listed rather than subject ranges. Nuances: BENG 102 and BENG 140A/140B each only count 2 of 4 units toward the engineering-content portion. BENG 199 / CENG 199 / ECE 199 / MAE 199 / NANO 199 require two quarters with the same faculty member (two quarters of BENG 199 satisfies both TE requirements). BENG 196 (industrial internship, 4 units) needs departmental Industrial Relations board approval. ENG 100D + two quarters of ENG 100L (TIES) together give the full 8 units. BENG 197 and BENG 198 may NOT count. All TEs must be taken for a letter grade and pre-approved by Student Affairs; prerequisites also required. ECE 253 is a graduate-level course but appears on the approved list.
